# Henrie Outfitters

> Henrie Outfitters LLC offers guided fishing and hunting trips in Southern Utah, led by owner and local expert James Henrie (25 years of outdoor experience). Home water is Panguitch Lake, and guided fishing trips are offered at six other Southern Utah lakes.

Book: call or text (435) 592-0680, email henrieoutfitters@gmail.com, or use the form at https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/#contact. Customized trip packages are available.

## Guided fishing trips by lake

- [Sand Hollow Reservoir](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/sand-hollow-reservoir.html): Red Rock Bass Factory, desert bass hunting. Chase largemouth bass in crystal blue water surrounded by Southern Utah red rock.
- [Lake Powell](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/lake-powell.html): Striper Canyon, canyon striper adventure. Run the canyons, find the bait and watch the stripers explode on the surface.
- [Navajo Lake](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/navajo-lake.html): Lava Tube Trout Lake, high alpine trout escape. High alpine trout fishing on a lake where the water disappears underground.
- [Panguitch Lake](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/panguitch-lake.html): Big Fish Reboot, trophy trout hunting. Fish the lake named ‘Big Fish’ for Southern Utah’s trophy trout.
- [Gunlock Reservoir](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/gunlock-reservoir.html): Comeback Waterfall Bass, intimate red rock bass fishing. Fish a red rock bass lake that came back from the brink.
- [Quail Creek Reservoir](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/quail-creek-reservoir.html): Record Factory, clear water trophy bass. A desert reservoir where stocked trout help grow trophy bass.
- [Fish Lake](https://firsttimemanager1-png.github.io/James/lakes/fish-lake.html): Alpine Mackinaw Lake, deep water mackinaw hunting. Go deep for a trophy Mackinaw in the heart of Utah’s high country.
